annotators: fresh-context agents of the developer model family, blind to the retrieval and to any validator; not independent human validation

heldout.note: sealed before any validator exists; not to be inspected until the validator is frozen

validatorFreeze.note: denotationOf (dn.1 after one development round) and alignWithType (v1: semantic-type gate) frozen before the held-out first run

transfer.note: fresh blind reference from the transfer packages (televisions, household dishwashers, dehumidifiers), never used to build or tune alignment; sealed before any semantic model or threshold was run on it (S76)

transferRunFreeze.note: configurations chosen on the examined dev and held-out references only, before any run on the sealed transfer reference

arms.what: cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall, variant c, rule concept->phrase entailment >= 0.7, no type gate
Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct label probabilities, identity >= 0.5, type gate
